events.title: Devlog #1
events.summary: Welcome to our first devlog! In this article, trentsignia from the WINE fan translation team takes us through the technical evolution of pixel art as shaped by developments in Japanese computing.Pixel art is a medium frequently defined by its limitations. It is tempting to consider the medium simplistic in light of such restrictions, but one only needs to trace the evolution of video game art to know that it is anything but. events.title: Dead of the Brain Demo Coming Soon!
events.summary: FAKKU is excited to announce that Dead of the Brain will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest!The demo will be available to play from the start of the event on October 19.You'll be able to dive into this cult classic game from Fairytale, one of the pioneering developers of games for the PC-98 platform in the 1980s and 90s, playable on modern platforms for the first time ever.Wishlist & FollowDon't forget to wishlist the game, follow our Steam publisher page, and check us out on social media.X
